dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Mildly concave trailing edge spline extending from dorsal ridge to the apex
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with low pixel radius at the morphological peak
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderately steep posterior inclination relative to the horizontal body axis
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio of approximately 1.2:1

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex curve fitted to the anterior-dorsal boundary
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short pixel length and thick vertical profile extending from the melon
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the transition point between the melon and rostrum

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan luminescence and low-poly geometric segmentation on the ventral fins
